import pytest
from csv_parser import parse_csv_line


class TestParseCsvLine:
    """Tests for parse_csv_line function."""

    # ==================== HAPPY PATH TESTS ====================

    def test_simple_fields(self):
        """Test with simple comma-separated fields."""
        result = parse_csv_line("a,b,c")
        assert result == ["a", "b", "c"]

    def test_single_field(self):
        """Test with a single field (no commas)."""
        result = parse_csv_line("hello")
        assert result == ["hello"]

    def test_quoted_field_with_comma(self):
        """Test quoted field containing a comma."""
        result = parse_csv_line('a,"quoted, field",c')
        assert result == ["a", "quoted, field", "c"]

    def test_quoted_field_at_start(self):
        """Test with quoted field at the beginning."""
        result = parse_csv_line('"start, quoted",middle,end')
        assert result == ["start, quoted", "middle", "end"]

    def test_quoted_field_at_end(self):
        """Test with quoted field at the end."""
        result = parse_csv_line('start,middle,"end, quoted"')
        assert result == ["start", "middle", "end, quoted"]

    def test_multiple_quoted_fields(self):
        """Test with multiple quoted fields."""
        result = parse_csv_line('"a,b",c,"d,e"')
        assert result == ["a,b", "c", "d,e"]

    def test_empty_fields_various_positions(self):
        """Test empty fields in various positions."""
        result = parse_csv_line("a,,c")
        assert result == ["a", "", "c"]

    def test_empty_first_field(self):
        """Test with empty first field."""
        result = parse_csv_line(",b,c")
        assert result == ["", "b", "c"]

    def test_empty_last_field(self):
        """Test with empty last field."""
        result = parse_csv_line("a,b,")
        assert result == ["a", "b", ""]

    def test_empty_middle_field(self):
        """Test with empty middle field."""
        result = parse_csv_line("a,,c")
        assert result == ["a", "", "c"]

    def test_whitespace_in_unquoted_field(self):
        """Test whitespace is preserved in unquoted fields."""
        result = parse_csv_line("  hello  ,world  ")
        assert result == ["  hello  ", "world  "]

    def test_whitespace_in_quoted_field(self):
        """Test whitespace is preserved in quoted fields."""
        result = parse_csv_line('"  hello  ","  world  "')
        assert result == ["  hello  ", "  world  "]

    def test_quote_toggle_in_quoted_content(self):
        """Test that quotes inside quotes toggle state."""
        # The current implementation toggles on each quote, so
        # "a"b"c" would toggle 4 times: start-quote, mid-quote, mid-quote, end-quote
        result = parse_csv_line('"a"b"c"')
        assert result == ["a\"b\"c"]

    # ==================== EDGE CASE TESTS ====================

    def test_empty_string(self):
        """Test with an empty string (empty line)."""
        result = parse_csv_line("")
        assert result == [""]

    def test_only_commas(self):
        """Test with only commas."""
        result = parse_csv_line(",,,")
        assert result == ["", "", "", ""]

    def test_quotes_only(self):
        """Test with only quotes and commas."""
        result = parse_csv_line('"",""')
        assert result == ["", ""]

    def test_trailing_comma(self):
        """Test with trailing comma."""
        result = parse_csv_line("a,b,")
        assert result == ["a", "b", ""]

    def test_leading_comma(self):
        """Test with leading comma."""
        result = parse_csv_line(",a,b")
        assert result == ["", "a", "b"]

    def test_consecutive_commas(self):
        """Test with consecutive commas."""
        result = parse_csv_line("a,,,b")
        assert result == ["a", "", "", "b"]

    def test_single_quoted_field(self):
        """Test with only a single quoted field."""
        result = parse_csv_line('"only field"')
        assert result == ["only field"]

    def test_empty_quoted_field(self):
        """Test with an empty quoted field."""
        result = parse_csv_line('""')
        assert result == [""]

    def test_multiple_empty_quoted_fields(self):
        """Test with multiple empty quoted fields."""
        result = parse_csv_line('"",""')
        assert result == ["", ""]

    def test_newlines_in_quoted_field(self):
        """Test that newlines inside quotes are treated as content."""
        result = parse_csv_line('"line1\nline2",end')
        assert result == ["line1\nline2", "end"]

    def test_special_characters_in_unquoted_field(self):
        """Test special characters in unquoted fields."""
        result = parse_csv_line("a#b$c%d")
        assert result == ["a#b$c%d"]

    def test_unicode_in_fields(self):
        """Test Unicode characters in fields."""
        result = parse_csv_line("hello,world,日本語")
        assert result == ["hello", "world", "日本語"]

    def test_mixed_quoted_and_unquoted_with_spaces(self):
        """Test mix of quoted and unquoted fields with spaces."""
        result = parse_csv_line('  unquoted  ,  "  quoted  "  ,end')
        assert result == ["  unquoted  ", "  quoted  ", "  end"]

    # ==================== ERROR/INVALID INPUT TESTS ====================

    def test_unclosed_quote_at_end(self):
        """Test unclosed quote at the end of line."""
        # Current behavior: unclosed quote means remaining text is inside quotes
        result = parse_csv_line('field1,field2,"unclosed')
        # The quote is never closed, so all remaining chars are quoted content
        assert result == ["field1", "field2", "unclosed"]

    def test_unclosed_quote_in_middle(self):
        """Test unclosed quote in the middle of line."""
        result = parse_csv_line('start,"unclosed,middle')
        assert result == ["start", "unclosed,middle"]

    def test_unclosed_quote_at_start(self):
        """Test unclosed quote at start of line."""
        result = parse_csv_line('"unclosed start,end')
        assert result == ["unclosed start,end"]

    def test_malformed_multiple_quotes(self):
        """Test with alternating quote states."""
        result = parse_csv_line('"a"b"c"d"e"')
        assert result == ['a"b"c"d"e']

    def test_quote_adjacent_to_comma(self):
        """Test quote immediately adjacent to comma."""
        result = parse_csv_line('a","b')
        assert result == ["a", "", "b"]

    def test_multiple_empty_fields(self):
        """Test sequence of multiple empty fields."""
        result = parse_csv_line(",,,,")
        assert result == ["", "", "", "", ""]
